description: Toy sandwich ingredients are spread out on the bed in front of a pink pillow: two bread slices, a green plate, and felt pieces for cheese, meat, bacon, tomato/onion, lettuce, and a yellow sauce blob. The right hand lifts a bread slice onto the green plate, then places cheese on top; the left hand adds the round meat and lays bacon strips over it, then both hands alternately bring on onion and tomato rings and press them down, followed by a lettuce leaf and the yellow sauce piece, and finally the right hand reaches toward the remaining bread slice to close the sandwich.
